official.deadline_note: GETFund publishes one deadline for both local categories: applications opened Monday 5 October 2026 and close Friday 27 November 2026, and the official portal's active '2026/27 Academic Year (Local)' season record carries the same postgraduate window (postgrad_end_date 27 November 2026). No separate institutional or faculty deadline is published, but because a valid admission letter from a local university is a prerequisite, the practical constraint is securing that admission before you can submit.
official.status_note: GETFund's notice of 2 October 2026 announces that applications for the 2026/27 Undergraduate and Postgraduate Local Scholarships opened on Monday 5 October 2026 and close on Friday 27 November 2026. The official GETFund Scholarship Portal's live settings show the application portal open, and its active local season is '2026/27 Academic Year (Local)' covering postgraduate and undergraduate applicants.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The programme page states: 'The Program provides financial, social, and academic support to Scholars. Financial support includes tuition fees, accommodation, and scholastic materials.' The same page's Funding and Duration FAQ records Local Scholarship Coverage as 'Tuition Fees Only', so accommodation and scholastic materials are stated in the programme's own wording but no monetary value is attached to any element.

official.application_route: Online only through the official GETFund Scholarship Portal at scholarships.getfund.gov.gh - register and verify an account, complete the online form, upload scanned supporting documents, review the summary and submit before 27 November 2026.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must be Ghanaian citizens, and the scheme funds study at Local Universities accredited by the Ghana Tertiary Education Commission to run Post Graduate courses (study within Ghana).
official.international_eligibility: No - this is the Local Scholarship for Master's and PhD study within Ghana. GETFund runs a separate Postgraduate Foreign Scholarship programme for study abroad.

Applicants cannot hold two or more scholarships from Ghana Government Agencies simultaneously.
official.research_requirement: Master's and PhD applicants must upload a project or research proposal not exceeding 5 pages.
official.duration: Valid for the postgraduate programme duration as specified in the admission letter, subject to satisfactory academic performance.
official.description: The Ghana Education Trust Fund's Postgraduate Local Scholarship supports 'brilliant but needy' Ghanaian applicants pursuing Master's and PhD programmes in the 2026/27 academic year at local universities accredited by the Ghana Tertiary Education Commission. GETFund states that the programme provides financial, social and academic support to Scholars, with financial support including tuition fees, accommodation and scholastic materials. Applications for the 2026/27 local scholarships opened on 5 October 2026 and close on 27 November 2026 through the official GETFund Scholarship Portal.

verification.notes: Application window, coverage wording, documents, requirements and disqualifying factors were read from GETFund's own 2 October 2026 announcement and its scholarships programme pages, and cross-checked against the live official portal (active season '2026/27 Academic Year (Local)' with postgraduate window 5 October to 27 November 2026 and portal settings showing applications open). GETFund publishes no monetary figure for the local scholarship on any official page, so the amount fields are recorded as null rather than sourced from aggregators.

applicant_utility.summary: GETFund's 2026/27 Postgraduate Local Scholarship is a package of tuition, accommodation and scholastic materials rather than a cash stipend, and the Fund publishes no monetary value for it, so do not budget a figure you have seen on an aggregator site. The window is unusually narrow - 5 October to 27 November 2026 - and you cannot start the form until you hold an admission letter from a GTEC-accredited Ghanaian university. Because sponsorship takes effect from the year of application rather than covering a whole programme retrospectively, a continuing student should apply in this cycle rather than waiting for their final year. Anything beyond tuition, accommodation and study materials is yours to fund, and the separate Foreign Scholarship scheme is a different, already-closed programme.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Ghanaian citizens already admitted (or about to be admitted) to a Master's or PhD at a GTEC-accredited Ghanaian university, from a 'brilliant but needy' background, who need tuition, accommodation and study-material support in the 2026/27 academic year.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure your admission letter first - GETFund accepts only unconditional or financial-condition letters from accredited local universities, and you cannot apply before university acceptance.
Obtain your university's official fee schedule and scan previous certificates and transcripts as clearly legible files before the busy final weeks.
Draft the research proposal to the exact published limit of five pages if you are a Master's or PhD applicant.
Line up your referees and request the occupational letter of recommendation early, plus an employer academic-leave support document if you are working.
Have your Ghana Card, passport bio page and National Service certificate (where applicable) scanned and ready.
Register on scholarships.getfund.gov.gh, verify the account, save progress as you go, then submit well before 27 November 2026.
common_rejection_risks: Uploading blurry, cropped or invisible scans - unclear documents are a published disqualifying factor.
Omitting the fee schedule or financial details, which GETFund lists alongside the admission letter as required documentation.
Submitting more than one application, which is an instant disqualification.
Holding another Ghanaian government scholarship at the same time - GETFund bars holding two or more simultaneously.
Re-applying as a previous GETFund beneficiary in the same category.
Treating the portal as editable: once submitted, changes cannot be made, and late or off-portal submissions are not processed.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: GETFund publishes no monetary value for the award, so nothing beyond tuition fees, accommodation and scholastic materials can be assumed. Budget for personal living costs, travel, research fieldwork and any expenses incurred before sponsorship takes effect (which begins in the year of application, not necessarily from the start of your programme).
document_audit: The admission letter must be an unconditional or financial-condition letter from an accredited local university - other letter types are not listed as acceptable.
The fee schedule is a separate required item; an admission letter on its own does not satisfy the financial-details requirement.
The five-page cap on the research proposal is a hard published limit for Master's and PhD applicants.
Employer academic-leave support is required where applicable - if you work, leaving it out is a common gap.
National Service certificate is required where applicable; check the portal's exact wording for your category.
Every upload must be legible, because invisible or unclear documents are a stated disqualifier.
alerts: Deadline trap: 27 November 2026 is a hard close and the portal cannot be edited after submission - aim to submit weeks early, not on the final day.

The GETFund page states 'Local Scholarship Coverage: Tuition Fees Only' in one FAQ while the Support Provided section names tuition, accommodation and scholastic materials - clarify what your award actually pays before you accept it.

All correspondence is exclusively between GETFund and the applicant, and GETFund warns that no intermediary is engaged to assist applicants - refuse anyone asking for money to process your application.
Do not confuse this with the separate 2026/27 Postgraduate Foreign Scholarship, which closed in April 2026 and funds study abroad.
GETFund enforces award acceptance: in a previous cycle beneficiaries who failed to accept offers by the stated deadline faced automatic revocation and forfeiture.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register and verify an account at scholarships.getfund.gov.gh, complete the online form, upload the scanned supporting and academic documents, review the summary and submit; GETFund then vets and shortlists applications and contacts shortlisted applicants by email and SMS through the portal.
